Corrected Statement and step 1.1 to name F_0,F_1. The compact oriented trace, opposite end signs, zero signed boundary, and fixed-endpoint perturbation in the mod-two supplier establish the unchanged endpoint equality and homotopy-class extension under AC_omega.

The proof uses only n=2, so the omission is nonfatal to this example: distinct planes have one common line, their sphere circles meet at two antipodal points with distinct tangents, and the local-diffeomorphism quotient gives one transverse intersection. Its parity is one and the homotopy obstruction follows under AC_omega. Example and all Statement/Definition interfaces unchanged.

The escaping branch makes the combined trace noncompact. This directly supports the remark. Explicit boundaryless sources match the defining interface; AC_omega is stated only for the extension.
